personality_one_liner: A warm, deeply personal, and cozy home cookbook experience that feels like flipping through a cherished family recipe journal.

spacing.rule: Use generous xl/2xl rhythm mimicking a notebook layout. Do not crowd elements.

do's: Skip glass to maintain the raw, matte, tactile paper feel of this personality
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism on headers, tab bars, or cards

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: A welcoming entry point that sets a cozy, home-cooking atmosphere.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with vertical top-to-bottom scrim (transparent -> surfaceInverse). White text overlay. Social login (Google) and Email/Password fields positioned in the bottom 40% of the screen. Primary CTA sticky at bottom.

screens.name: Planner
screens.purpose: A 7-day weekly canvas (Saturday to Friday) allowing users to map out lunches and dinners intuitively.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for the days of the week.
states.empty: Hand-drawn style illustration of a notebook with a CTA to 'Add your first meal'.
states.error: Readable error message with a retry button.

screens.layout: Top section: Horizontal week selector (prev/current/next) with the current day prominently highlighted using brandPrimary. Main scrollable area: 7 vertical day blocks (Saturday to Friday). Inside each day, segmented slots for 'Pranzo' (Lunch) and 'Cena' (Dinner). If empty, display a dashed-border 'Add Meal' placeholder. If filled, show a minimalist dish card with servings counter and an edit/remove button. Floating sticky button at bottom for 'Duplicate Previous Week'.

screens.name: Spesa (Shopping List)
screens.purpose: An interactive, drag-and-drop grocery list merging manual entries and auto-populated ingredients from the Planner.

states.empty: Illustration of fresh vegetables with text 'Your cart is empty. Start planning or add items manually.'

screens.layout: Header banner featuring a blurred or masked image of fresh vegetables. Main area: A vertical list of ingredients using React Native Gesture Handler for drag-and-drop reordering. Each row has a drag handle on the right. Items added from the Planner carry a subtle 'brandSecondary' (sage) dot indicator to distinguish from manual items. Checkboxes on the left; checking an item strikes through the text and fades the row opacity.

screens.name: Piatti (Dishes)
screens.purpose: A digital recipe box to create, search, and manage Primi (First Courses) and Secondi (Second Courses).

states.empty: Illustration of an empty plate. Text: 'No dishes yet. Add your favorite recipes.'
states.error: Could not fetch dishes. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Sticky header with a search bar (surfaceTertiary background) and a segmented control to toggle between 'Primi' and 'Secondi'. Below, a 2-column masonry or simple 1-column list of recipe cards. Cards feature a thumbnail (if available), title, prep time, and course tag. A primary FAB (Floating Action Button) positioned bottom-right to 'Create New Dish'.

screens.name: Create/Edit Dish Modal
screens.purpose: A full-screen sheet to input dish details, ingredients, quantities, and preparation steps.

states.error: Validation error text under respective fields.

screens.layout: Modal/Sheet presentation. Single-column scrollable form. Fields for Dish Name, Course Type (Picker: Primo/Secondo), Ingredients list (dynamic rows to add name + quantity), and a multiline text area for Preparation instructions. Primary 'Save' CTA sticky at the bottom, respecting the safe area and keyboard avoiding view.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design with a 'Hand-Drawn / Journal' aesthetic: rely on soft margins, asymmetrical spacing, and warm off-white (FDFBF7) and cream (F5F2EB) backgrounds instead of heavy cards or glassmorphism. Avoid shadows (shadow_tier 0) and pure whites.
Typography requires 'Fraunces' for elegant serif headings and 'Nunito' for soft, friendly body text. Max font weight everywhere is 500.

For the Spesa (Shopping) tab: Implement react-native-gesture-handler for drag-and-drop functionality. Auto-populated items from the Planner MUST show a visual dot in 'brandSecondary' (sage) to distinguish them from manual entries.
Planner structure MUST strictly operate from Saturday to Friday per the user's specific requirement. Implement a week-selector at the top (e.g., arrows for prev/next week).
When a dish is added to the planner, logic must scale ingredient quantities by the chosen servings before adding to the shopping list.
Images used as backgrounds (e.g., Auth) MUST use the gradient scrim pattern (top-to-bottom transparent to surfaceInverse at >= 70% opacity) to guarantee readability of overlaid text.
Wire haptics directly into interactions (e.g., selection haptic for tab changes, impactMedium for adding dishes/saving form, impactHeavy for starting a drag-and-drop).
